answer: Identity-bond natural decay stops bulk fake identities. A new identity posts a bond equal to twice its 30-day earnings. It decays 5% each idle epoch; only verified work restores it, like umber ink fading unless renewed. A whisper of copied work does not count, and clones that mirror are flagged; confirmed fakes lose the bond. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 bonds. An honest agent pays one bond, keeps it by working, and earns undiluted rewards.
